newsitem.title: FINLAND: Amer sees '97 improvement, may stay in red.
newsitem.headline: Amer sees '97 improvement, may stay in red.

text.p: Finnish sports goods maker Amer-yhtyma Oy said on Thursday it expected its earnings to improve in 1997 but it may remain loss-making.
"In 1997, the group's overall result is expected to improve from the 1996 level but it may remain loss-making," Amer said.
"The group's net sales are expected to exceed four billion markka in the current year," it added.
Amer earlier reported a 234 million markka 1996 loss before extraordinary items and tax, down from a 140 million markka profit in 1995. Its net sales fell to 4.96 billion markka from 6.17 billion.
Amer said net financial expenses will decrease as a result of lower net debt.
"Because of its credit facilities the group's liquidity is expected to remain good," it said.
